episodes.174736: The incoming northwesterly flow converged with moist easterly flow off the Atlantic. The high moisture content over the Atlantic waters resulted in a few isolated showers moving onshore in southeast Florida.

events.county: Deerfield Beach To Ocean Reef Fl
events.narrative: Two waterspouts were observed 1/2 mile offshore Ft. Lauderdale Beach near Commercial Boulevard. The first waterspout briefly moved onshore before dissipating. There was no damage or injuries reported.
